entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
The name is Sarah Miller. Order number is VF78901.
Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see you're one of our VIP members, thank you for your loyalty. I see the Aero Race Jersey on this order. Is that the item you're calling about?
Okay. And just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the wrong size. It's way too tight.

I see. Sizing can be tricky with our race-fit items. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, it looks like it arrived 84 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so that's no problem at all. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
An exchange, I guess. Assuming you have it.

We absolutely do. I can set up that exchange right now. And since you're a VIP member, I'll upgrade the shipping to complimentary 2-day express for you. I'm also emailing you a pre-paid return label to send the original jersey back to us. Does that work for you?
Excellent. The exchange order is placed, and that email with the return label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sarah?
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
